interpretation.plain_speak: Within this tighter forward/reverse history family, native correct-count tracks the needed calibration correction fairly strongly. But another fixed profile family produced a much weaker relationship and larger same-count spread. So count is informative, but not sufficient across history families.
interpretation.north_star_question: Suggests a useful scalar risk coordinate exists, but it needs at least one additional native topology or trajectory feature to transfer across history families.
interpretation.next_stage: combine the two fixed UP-191B diagnostic families without fitting and test which endogenous margin-geometry feature explains residual correction differences at matched or similar native counts
